versions.subject: rules: advancedrun executions
versions.detection:
selection:
    - Image|endswith: '\AdvancedRun.exe'
    - CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' /EXEFilename '
        - ' /Run'
    - CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' /WindowState 0'
        - ' /RunAs '
        - ' /CommandLine '
condition: selection
versions.spl: Image="*\\AdvancedRun.exe" OR (CommandLine="* /EXEFilename *" CommandLine="* /Run*") OR (CommandLine="* /WindowState 0*" CommandLine="* /RunAs *" CommandLine="* /CommandLine *")
